import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl

def top_sales(df):
    # Convert to narwhals dataframe
    nw_df = nw.from_native(df)
    
    # Filter rows where amount > 100 and sort by amount descending
    result = nw_df.filter(nw.col("amount") > 100).sort("amount", descending=True)
    
    # Convert back to native type
    return result.to_native()

# Test with pandas
pdf = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["A", "B", "C", "D"],
    "amount": [50, 150, 75, 200]
})
print("Pandas result:")
print(top_sales(pdf))

# Test with polars
plf = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["A", "B", "C", "D"],
    "amount": [50, 150, 75, 200]
})
print("\nPolars result:")
print(top_sales(plf))
